baseline_expectation.note: The measured revision for the round-26 claim must report 0 of 27 mismatches with exit 0. A baseline that is not clean makes every mutant inconclusive, not killed.

declared_rules.K01_K06: SCORECARD.md:903 (round-26 declaration, attempt 1). The declaring round N is the number in the heading of the current axes table, which must read `## Axes — current self-assessment (round N)`; a heading without a round number exits 2. The ordinal reference is the last match of the round-25 refinement regex (SCORECARD.md:807) on SCORECARD lines outside that table, excluding every line inside a section whose heading (any level) names round N (`Round N` or `round N` as a whole number), unless that heading also contains `measured outcome`.
declared_rules.K07_K23: SCORECARD.md:795 and SCORECARD.md:807 (round-25 declaration and its refinements), unchanged by round 26.
declared_rules.K24_K27: SCORECARD.md:904 (round-26 declaration, attempt 1). For SHONEN boxes 1 to 4: every corpus/knowledge/*.md path the box names exists at <REV> and carries no supersession marker, meaning none of its first 20 lines matches the case-insensitive word `superseded`.

runner_contract.sandbox: git -C <lane repo> archive <rev> | tar -x -C <sandbox>; git init with no remote; git add -A; git commit (sandbox-local base commit); apply edits; git commit; run the detector at HEAD; git reset --hard <base> && git clean -fd; compare the tree digest with the pristine digest.
runner_contract.restoration: Every mutant is restored to the pristine tree inside the sandbox; the lane repository is never written to.
runner_contract.verdict_rule: killed = the detector exit code differs from the baseline exit code; survived = the detector exit code equals the baseline; inconclusive = the baseline failed, the tool is not the v2 check set, or a precondition is unmet.

v2_divergence.summary: The measured v2 implementation and the declared K01 to K06 rule disagree on where an ordinal transition may be recorded.
v2_divergence.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 reads the ordinal reference as the last match of the round-25 refinement regex on SCORECARD lines outside the current axes table, excluding every line inside a section whose heading names round N unless that heading also contains `measured outcome`.
v2_divergence.measured_behaviour: The measured v2 implementation reports its reference as the last ordinal transition in a measured-outcome section (its reason strings read 'no coverage ordinal transition in any measured-outcome section'), so a transition in any other section is ignored.
v2_divergence.resolution: Integrator decision, not made by this seat. Each of the four mutants carries an `alt_expected` block for the narrower reading, and the runner reports `expectation_met` (declared rule) and `expectation_met_alt` (narrower rule) separately, so the catalogue stays usable under either ruling.

mutants.title: Declaring-round prose states a false ordinal transition (depth 8 -> 7)
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 — a declaring round's own declaration and refinement prose can never satisfy its own ordinal check.

edits.text: Mutation probe: the declaring round's own prose mentions `depth 8 → 7` as an example of a non-move.

mutants.rationale: The false transition sits inside a section whose heading names round 26 and does not contain `measured outcome`, so it is excluded from the ordinal search. K01 to K06 must not change. If the tool counts it, K01 reports observed 7 against stated 8 and the mutant is killed — that would mean the v2 exclusion did not land.

mutants.title: False ordinal transition under the round's `measured outcome` heading (depth 8 -> 7)
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 — only the measured outcome can record a move.
mutants.rationale: The section heading names round 26 but also contains `measured outcome`, so its lines are not excluded. The last depth transition becomes 7 while the axes table states 8, so K01 must mismatch.

mutants.title: Current axes heading reads `Round26` without a space
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 — the heading must read `## Axes — current self-assessment (round N)`; a heading without a round number exits 2.
mutants.alt_rationale: Under the looser reading, in which the round number may be written in any form inside the axes heading, `(Round26)` names round 26, the check set is evaluated and nothing changes. The measured v2 implementation behaves this way.
mutants.rationale: `Round26` is not the declared `Round N` / `round N` form, so the declaring round number N cannot be read and the check set cannot be evaluated: exit 2, never a pass.
mutants.ambiguity: A looser implementation that parses the digits out of any heading would report N = 26 and evaluate the set, which would make this mutant survive. The declared text gives only the `round N` form, so exit 2 is the expected reading.

mutants.title: Current axes heading carries no round number
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 — a heading without a round number exits 2.
mutants.rationale: With no round number in the axes heading the declaring round N is unknown, so K01 to K06 cannot be scoped and the tool must exit 2.

mutants.title: Measured-outcome heading reads `Round26` without a space, with a false ordinal transition inside it
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:903 — a section is excluded only when its heading names round N as `Round N` or `round N` as a whole number.
mutants.rationale: `Round26` does not name round 26 in the declared form, so the section is not excluded and its transition counts: K01 mismatches. If the implementation instead matches the bare digits, the section would be excluded and the mutant would survive — that is the discriminating signal this mutant exists for.

mutants.title: SHONEN box 1 cites a superseded corpus note
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:904 — K24 to K27: a corpus/knowledge/*.md path named by a SHONEN box must carry no supersession marker in its first 20 lines.
mutants.rationale: The cited note exists at the revision, so K20 still passes, but its first 20 lines carry the case-insensitive word `superseded`, so the new K24 must mismatch. The runner resolves the note at the revision so the mutant survives a reworded SHONEN.md.

mutants.title: SHONEN box 1 cites a corpus note that does not exist
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:904 and SCORECARD.md:795 — the named corpus/knowledge/*.md path must exist at <REV> (K20 existence, K24 v2 existence).
mutants.rationale: The named path is absent at the revision, so both the existence clause of K20 and the existence clause of K24 must mismatch.

mutants.title: SHONEN box 1 cites an existing, non-superseded corpus note (control)
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:904 — a note with no supersession marker in its first 20 lines is accepted.
mutants.rationale: Control for M11: the same edit shape, a note that exists and carries no marker, must leave the detector at the baseline.

mutants.title: SHONEN box 1 cites a note whose supersession marker sits beyond line 20
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:904 — the marker counts only when one of the note's first 20 lines matches `superseded` (case-insensitive).

mutants.title: Later ordinal line `depth 8 -> 9` outside any round-26 section
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:807 and SCORECARD.md:903 — the ordinal reference is the last match outside the current axes table, with round-26 sections excluded.
mutants.alt_rationale: Under the narrower reading, in which only a measured-outcome section records a move, a transition in an appendix section is not an ordinal at all, so nothing changes and the mutant survives. The runner records both readings; see the v2_divergence note.
mutants.rationale: Round-25 survivor (MutC1Ordinals m2), replayed against the round-26 table: a later depth transition outside the round-26 sections must be picked up, so K01 mismatches.

mutants.rationale: Round-25 survivor (MutC1Ordinals m4): the after-value is out of range, so the line is not an ordinal and the detector must not change.

mutants.title: Ordinal arrow inside the round-26 depth row of the axes table

mutants.rationale: Round-25 survivor (MutC1Ordinals m5): a transition inside the current axes table is excluded, so nothing changes.

mutants.title: Self-consistent pair: depth score cell raised to 9 and a matching later transition appended
mutants.declared_rule: SCORECARD.md:807 — the six checks test agreement with the lane's own records, not an outside judgement.
mutants.alt_rationale: Under the narrower reading, in which only a measured-outcome section records a move, the score cell 9 has no move record to support it (the synthetic measured outcome still says 8), so K01 mismatches and the mutant is killed.
mutants.rationale: Round-25 survivor (MutC1Ordinals m10): a score no move record supports is still accepted when the prose agrees with itself. A survivor is a coverage finding, not a contract change.
